title: What The Balalaika Knows — EN/RU/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Russian German philosophy language learning melancholy winter
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The balalaika is a triangular-bodied Russian string affair
Three sides, three strings, one instrument that needs no compare
The shape makes certain structural and acoustic compromises
That somehow produce a sound that continuously surprises

[Verse 2 — Russian, with English translation]
Балалайка знает зиму лучше всех нас
[The balalaika knows winter better than all of us]
Три струны держат историю — каждый раз
[Three strings hold history — every time]
В её треугольной форме — душа России
[In its triangular form — the soul of Russia]
Балалайка поёт о том, что было и что было красиво
[The balalaika sings of what was and what was beautiful]

[Chorus — English]
What does the balalaika know that I don't know?
It knows the depth of winter when the Volga's under snow
What does the balalaika know in a Russian night?
It knows that melancholy played with virtuosity is right
That's my boy

[Bridge — German, with English translation]
Die Balalaika weiß, was Kälte wirklich bedeutet
[The balalaika knows what cold truly means]
Ein dreieckiges Holz, das die Seele deutet
[A triangular wood that interprets the soul]
Russland und Deutschland — beide kennen den Winter gut
[Russia and Germany — both know winter well]
Die Balalaika spielt, was das Herz nicht sagen konnt
[The balalaika plays what the heart could not say]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the balalaika knows… Что знает балалайка… Was die Balalaika weiß
Winter always returns — Зима всегда вернётся — Winter kommt immer zurück
That's my boy
